title: Impulse Winding Tester 19301A
seoDescription: Impulse winding tester for EV motor and chip inductor test solutions.

props.title: Impulse Winding Tester 19301A
paragraphs: Impulse winding tester for EV motor and chip inductor test solutions.

props.body:
- 10V ~ 1000V impulse voltage test
- 0.25V test resolution
- High impulse test sampling rate (200MHz), 10bits
- 20mS high speed test (P1.0)
- Inductance contact check function
- Inductance differential voltage compensation function
